integrity: Analytical all-dimension proof with independent finite rational checks; geometric embedding, nesting, and barycenter are credited to original literature. No claim of mathematical independence or absolute exhaustive novelty.
scientific_limitations: Standard unweighted coordinate embeddings and uniform measures on vertices only; no result about body-volume inertia, other realizations, or independent validation. Equivalent calculations in unindexed Catalan-statistics literature remain a bibliographic possibility.
title: A dimension-eleven reversal of vertex inertia in Loday's nested polytopes
